summary: State machine driven by the state word at this+0x0 and called by PitTimer (0x004D2E50). States -1 (0xFFFFFFFF), 0, 1 and 5 are blocked and return 0 with no mutation. States 2 and 3 dispatch a virtual call through the pointer at this+0x4, store the dispatch result into this+0x8C and this+0x90, write the global dword_7C54DC (CurrentPlayerIndex) into this+0x94, transition to state 4 and return 1. State 4 is the active state and returns 1. Any other state value is treated as an error: the state word is set to -1 and the function returns 0.

operations.description: Dispatch on the state word at this+0x0 through the jump table jpt_40DD8B; states 0xFFFFFFFF, 0, 1 and 5 fall through to the blocked path.
Default case: a state value not in the handled set is an error, so the state word is set to 0xFFFFFFFF.
Call VirtualDispatchHelper with the pointer stored at this+0x4; the returned pointer is captured as v2.
Store the dispatch result into the two consecutive slots this+0x8C and this+0x90.
Store the global dword_7C54DC (CurrentPlayerIndex) into this+0x94.
On states 2 and 3 the state word is set to 4, entering the active state.
Return 1 for the active states (4, and 2/3 after the transition); return 0 for the blocked, default and error paths.
